slot_scores.name: missing_minimize_hours_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total number of hours worked across all four assigned tasks, or is there a different objective such as minimizing the maximum hours for any single worker?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is minimizing total hours, directly covering the hidden objective.

slot_scores.name: worker_at_most_one_task_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single selected worker be assigned to more than one of the four tasks, or must each selected worker be assigned to exactly one task?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether a selected worker can take multiple tasks or must take exactly one, fully covering the hidden assignment rule.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved both the P0 objective slot and the P1 worker-task assignment slot before entering READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that recovered both hidden modeling facts, confirming the minimization objective and the exactly-one-task-per-selected-worker rule before proceeding to model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
